requirements: Users can only access their own profile.
conditions: Access is allowed if requesting_user_id is equal to requested_user_id.
Access must be denied if requesting_user_id is not equal to requested_user_id.

tests.name: access_own_profile
tests.description: Verify that user 101 can successfully access profile 101.

tests.name: access_other_profile
tests.description: Verify that user 101 cannot access profile 102 and receives a PermissionError.
